title: What I Learned From DeepSeek's Harness
product_promise: Explain why the same model swings 47-67% by harness alone; hand the viewer three copyable practices and the rent/churn/own sort — as a finished ledger-editorial film.

style_reference.inherited_system: One visual spine, finite layout vocabulary, typography-led argument, deliberately sparse illustrative resets, phrase-level captions, and a quiet branded ending with a held chord.
style_reference.rejected_legacy_pattern: No generic slideshow, full-frame blog-image deck, blank title stage, dashboard/terminal collage, or visual change chosen only to decorate narration.
style_reference.deliberate_deviation: This film replaces Clean Indigo's indigo visual family with the ledger-editorial porcelain/ink world so the session-log argument becomes the film grammar; it keeps the same discipline of authored scenes, motion continuity, caption safety, and sparse image resets.

beats.entry_visual: Cover-hero at frame zero: article title, subtitle, and Aaron brand lockup already readable on the porcelain field; the 47/67 count-up statement is the first change inside it.
beats.visual_reason: The contradiction is numeric; typography owns it. Opening on an illustration would restart the rejected slide-deck grammar.
beats.camera_or_motion: count-up on 47%/67%, then a quiet system line (you — harness — model) drawn as the ledger rail appears for the first time.
beats.sound_cue: score enters before first word: low cello + pulse establish stakes; duck under narration.
beats.fallback: static statement with both numbers set

beats.entry_visual: SEQ 01 ledger line appends; Ronacher quotation page assembles with visible attribution (The Register, 2026-08-14).
beats.visual_reason: The winner's own words are the authority anchor; a quiet serif quote page reads as journalism, not marketing.
beats.camera_or_motion: word-mask on the quotation; then a mono method line (fourteen passes · one commit · a few hundred claims) staggers in.
beats.asset_provenance: Verbatim quotation from fact-ronacher; method stats from fact-pack source-dsh-repo.
beats.sound_cue: felt piano takes over; pulse recedes.

beats.entry_visual: SEQ 02 appends; a billing ledger scaffold (prefix rows, discount column) is visible before the first sentence completes.
beats.visual_reason: Cache economics is a ledger story; the lawyer still is the chapter's one warm medium reset after ~90s of typography.
beats.camera_or_motion: ledger rows accumulate for the caching explanation; crossfade to the contract still for the lawyer beat; back to a six-second safe/key statement; then the timestamp row strikes coral and every row below re-prices.
beats.sound_cue: piano continues; a single low cello note under 'full price, forever.'

beats.entry_visual: SEQ 03 appends; a column of check entries is already stacked in muted state.
beats.visual_reason: The CI assertion is itself a ledger of green states ending in one refusal — the film's grammar and the subject coincide.
beats.camera_or_motion: stagger entries downward; the refusal entry lands coral with a flag; hold; the closing tease line masks in.
beats.asset_provenance: fact-cache-test; no green in film — passing entries are ink+cyan, refusal is coral.
beats.sound_cue: score thins; pulse only, preparing the signature scene's near-dry entry.
beats.transition_out: cut to ink page (the film's one dark punctuation frame)

beats.entry_visual: Ink page: SEQ 04 alone in mono, then the porcelain field returns as the ledger cascade begins accumulating rows immediately.
beats.visual_reason: The 44/3 cascade is the film's one signature scene: the structure the viewer has watched all along becomes the subject.
beats.camera_or_motion: 44 rows accumulate as texture; exactly three flip cyan and advance to reading size; the rest dim. Then system-map: ledger spine → derived cards → gate → request, connector-draw with arrowheads at 0.98. Replay beat scrubs the rail backward via focus-shift. Five-line assertion masks in as the payoff band.
beats.sound_cue: near-dry for the cascade (pulse only, very low); piano re-enters at the replay beat.
beats.fallback: cascade static peak frame; map static with all states resolved

beats.entry_visual: SEQ 05 appends; the hanging-machine still enters as the chapter's conceptual reset with a mono margin label.
beats.visual_reason: The irony (huge machine, one row) is faster as an image; the config row itself then deserves mono typography at reading size.
beats.camera_or_motion: still holds calm; focus-shift to a mono config row card; 'disabled: true' types onto the row and the machine line dims. 178-green-tests statement with a torn gap; 27 checks count-up (static fallback).
beats.sound_cue: cello returns under the crash story; brief silence after 'died the moment a real editor connected.'
beats.fallback: mono row card without the still

beats.entry_visual: SEQ 06 appends; the fleet still enters with a mono stat rail (12,293 · 64 days · codex/ 209) already scaffolded.
beats.visual_reason: Who-built is the chapter Aaron weighted most; the still carries the humans-rules/fleet-executes argument, then the process OS reads as ledger entries — the film's grammar again.
beats.camera_or_motion: stat rail counts up over the still; markdown-vs-TypeScript as a two-bar mono comparison; then three process entries stagger in (day-two note / rejected freezer / verified-red) with the payoff line 'the writer never gets tired.'
beats.sound_cue: pulse forward (the fleet); piano answers on the payoff line.
beats.fallback: typographic stat page without the still

beats.entry_visual: SEQ 07 appends; the film's quietest page — three muted limitation rows already legible.
beats.visual_reason: Honesty reads as stillness; then the strategy read gets the film's one split comparison, explicitly labeled as Aaron's read.
beats.camera_or_motion: limitation rows sit almost still (focus-shift only); compare-wipe into split-loop: moat lane vs funnel lane, conclusion band 'portability cuts both ways.' A mono 'my read' label is visible for the whole lane sequence.
beats.sound_cue: near-silence for the catch; strings re-enter softly for the play.

beats.entry_visual: SEQ 08 appends; three ledger slips (assertion / cache trio / rejected folder) scaffolded in muted state.
beats.visual_reason: The payoff is a sorting action; slips that the viewer can almost pick up, then the shelves still grounds the two-column close.
beats.camera_or_motion: slips activate one by one (stagger); rent/churn/own resolves as three mono lines; crossfade to the two-shelves still; the two-column statement enters after the still settles; series pointer as a final mono ledger line SEQ 09 · THE ENTRY FEE.
beats.sound_cue: piano+cello resolve; the held chord begins under the final sentence.

beats.entry_visual: Brand end card: soft mark, AARON GUO, AI-NATIVE BUILDER · HUMAN-FIRST THINKER; header and captions hidden.
beats.visual_reason: Established sign-off; the argument has ended.

beats.sound_cue: held chord alone, fading to silence.
